COURSES OFFERED BY DEPARTMENT OF URDU

GENERIC ELECTIVE COURSE -26 (GE-26) URDU SAFARNAMA
CREDIT DISTRIBUTION, ELIGIBILITY AND PRE-REQUISITES OF THE COURSE

Learning Objectives
The Learning Objectives of this course are as follows:
To underline the traces of travelogue in Urdu literature.
Do reading of literary texts through travelogue
Learning outcomes
The Learning Outcomes of this course are as follows:
To learn the history of travelogue in Urdu literature.
To understand travelogue literary texts through short stories.
UNIT I (15 Hours)
1. 2. Safarnaame ka Fun (Art of Travelogue writing)
Urdu mein Safarnaame ka Aghaz-o-Irtiqa (Origin and Development of
Travelogue writing in Urdu)
UNIT - II (10 Hours)
Safarnaame (Types of Travelogue writing- Tourism, Haj, Humour and satirical)
4. Safarnaame aur Reportage meim mumaasilaten aur Farq. (Similarities and differences of Travelogue writing and Reportage)
UNIT - IIl (10 Hours)
Posh (20 pages from begining).
UNIT - IV (10 Hours)
Practical component (if any) - NIL
